caption: The video captures a fixed landscape view of a calm, dark-blue lake mirroring a range of snow-capped grey mountains beneath a clear blue sky. A golden-brown grassy hill slopes down on the left to the waterline, edged with dry orange reeds and shrubs, while bare branches intrude at the right edge and a thin reed rises at the bottom-left. A small white building and dark trees sit on the far shore at right, beside a bright reflection. The mountains, hill, sky, and shoreline remain fixed within the frame. The lake surface is not perfectly still, as faint ripple lines continuously appear, shift, and fade across the reflected image of the snow peaks and the golden slope. These ripples make the mirror image shimmer and break into wavy streaks frame by frame. Meanwhile, the bare branches and reed remain essentially motionless.
